faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR IARI Young Professional-II (YP-II) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the ICAR IARI Young Professional-II (YP-II) position is 03 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree in Genetics, Plant Breeding, Genetics & Plant Breeding, Biotechnology, Plant Pathology, or allied disciplines of Life Sciences.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 42,000 per month. No House Rent Allowance (HRA) will be provided.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Applications need to be sent via email with all required documents attached. The specific email address will be mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for ICAR IARI Young Professional-II (YP-II) posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection methods for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Online Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Young Professional-II (YP-II) is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for ICAR IARI, with the specific location mentioned as Dharwad, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from any state apply for this position?
faq.answer: The notification specifies Karnataka as the state for this recruitment. Candidates from other states may also be eligible, but it's advisable to check the official notification for any specific domicile requirements.
